description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: burning wall torch on a wooden post, old abandoned mining cart, broken wooden support beam, small stone gargoyle statue on a pedestal, rusty iron chain on the ground, old wooden crate, cave signpost, stone altar with carvings, skull pile with candles, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
